## Où j'en suis
Terraform for the PostgreSQL 17 blue/green upgrade is prepared: staging plans one add and one change, while production is prepared but disabled and plans no changes. A draft PR is open; nothing has been applied.

- [en-cours] PR #57 is open; staging still needs the pg_partman upgrade and validation before applying.
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman on staging to 5.x, then check maintenance for `events_raw` and `events_daily`.
- [prochaine-étape] Get Maya’s sign-off, then choose a production window outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock.
- [essai-raté] Initial `terraform init` failed because the lock file had AWS provider 5.31.0; `init -upgrade` selected v6 and caused unrelated plan changes. Pinning to 5.82 resolved this.
- [décision] Do not apply anything; keep work plan-only (source: t01)
- [décision] No production date until Maya signs off; keep `apply_immediately` false (source: t14)
